resources.string: Confirm the arrival of pre-registered patients or register a direct arrival.
When a patient submits one from the app, it will appear here.
Arrivals confirmed by reception will appear here.
Status of encounters and the most recent arrivals.
Queue by level and waiting time
The queue prioritized by triage level and waiting time will appear here, with data from the server.
Summary of encounters by status and by location.
The tenant has no registered locations.
Times, compliance, agreement and the CSV download will appear here.

The indicators show how many pre-registrations are waiting for confirmation and how many encounters are waiting for triage. The screen updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. Select a site to filter the indicators and the pre-registrations. Verify identity before confirming arrival. You can reject a pre-registration with a reason or open direct registration.

This is the nursing tray. The indicator shows how many encounters are waiting for triage. The list updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. Select a site and open an encounter to record clinical information. Use Previous and Next to change pages.

This screen summarizes encounters by status: waiting for triage, triaged and in care. Below you will see the most recent encounters; open one to review its details. It updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. The queue by level and waiting time is not available yet. The guide does not read patient data.

This screen summarizes encounters by status and those waiting for triage at each location. It updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. Time reports and the CSV download are not available yet. The screen does not show patient data.
